title: Largest Gaps between Eigenvalues of the Gaussian Orthogonal Ensemble
summary: We determine the asymptotic distribution of the largest gaps between consecutive eigenvalues of the Gaussian orthogonal ensemble (GOE) in the bulk of the spectrum. After an explicit centering and scaling, the largest gaps in a fixed interval converge to a Poisson point process with an exponential intensity, so the largest gap has a shifted Gumbel limit. The analogous result for the Gaussian unitary ensemble was proved by Feng and Wei.
